description: Saves an API key or token a scene's tables send (sealed; never shown again). A table names it as "$secret:<name>" in a header value or a URL's query. A name that exists already has its value replaced, and tables using it send the new one. Only a key the user gave you. Answers name and updatedAt.

value.description: The API key or token itself, exactly as the user gave it
